source_title: Top 3 Minecraft Mod Startup Crashes & How to Fix Them
exception_type: Mod startup: missing dependency / invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER / MixinApplyError
raw_log:
Example: NetherPortalFix requires balm-fabric, but the dependency isn't installed
A related error may contain “net/minecraft/client or DEDICATED_SERVER”.
Common errors include: MixinTransformerError, MixinApplyError, InjectionError, and InvalidMixinException
fix_solution:
Missing dependency: Check the crash message for the missing dependency, find it on CurseForge/Modrinth matching your MC version and loader, upload to Files -> mods, restart.
Client-only mod: find the mod named in the error, confirm it is client-only, open Files -> mods and remove it, start again.
Mixin/conflict: open newest crash report, search for 'Caused by:', temporarily remove the recently added/updated mod and restart; use binary search (remove half the mods) if unclear.
notes: 场景:other(mod 启动崩溃三类:缺依赖/client-only mod/Mixin 冲突);教学文仅列错误特征,无单一完整堆栈,quality=low。托管商知识库教学文章:raw_log 为该文引用的报错特征原文(非某台真实服务器的完整崩溃报告,通常无插件列表/系统信息),fix_solution 为该文修复步骤原文;故质量不评 high。;清洗2026-08-28:fix=保留KB原文;quality=low→low
